item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 11/Nov/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring generally fine weather to southern China in the next few days. A fresh northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coastal areas early next week. With the anticyclone aloft weakening in the middle and latter parts of next week, it will be cloudier over the region.

Date/Month: 12/11 (Saturday)
Wind: East force 3 to 4, force 5 offshore in the morning.
Weather: Mainly fine. Cloudy periods in the morning. Hot during the day.
Temp range: 23 - 28 C
R.H. range: 60 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
